verdict.rationale: Caveman ships a skill, an open-source CLI and a cloud platform, so controlling how skill updates roll out to a team is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions version pinning, a lockfile, or any control over when skill updates reach users. The closest item is an audit trail of who changed budgets, guardrails, keys and roles (docs-20). That is an adjacent governance feature, not skill version control.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control when skill changes reach my team — pinned versions or a lockfile rather than silent behind-the-back updates
